npcs.name: Biscuit
npcs.title: Haybright's Sheepdog (Retired)
npcs.bark: *thump, thump* (That is his tail. He is not getting up.)

npcs.name: Hedda Haybright
npcs.title: Bruna's Mum
npcs.bark: Wipe your feet! Not you, Biscuit. You can't.

npcs.name: Tam Haybright
npcs.title: The Smallest Haybright
npcs.bark: The scarecrow WALKS. Nobody believes me.

npcs.name: Nib
npcs.title: A Very Small Gnoll
npcs.bark: Nib is not here. Nib is a scarecrow.

npcs.name: Nib
npcs.title: Haybright's Newest Farmhand
npcs.bark: Nib has a HAT. And a JOB. And a SPOON he did not steal.

npcs.name: Reeve Hester Applegarth
npcs.title: Reeve of Amberfield
npcs.bark: If it's about the oil, take a number. If it's about pie, take a seat.

npcs.name: Tamsin Pell
npcs.title: Miller of Amberfield
npcs.bark: Mill by day, oil-press by night. Well. Used to be.

npcs.name: Ser Corlan Hale
npcs.title: Heronguard (Retired)
npcs.bark: Rows straight, beans staked, gate shut. Discipline.

npcs.name: Old Hob Waxley
npcs.title: Beekeeper
npcs.bark: Mind the bees. They don't mind you.

npcs.name: Old Ida Crook
npcs.title: Shepherd of the Ring
npcs.bark: Count the stones, count the sheep. One of them's always missing.

npcs.name: Duchess
npcs.title: A Sheep of Some Importance
npcs.bark: Baa.

npcs.name: Wobble
npcs.title: A Sheep
npcs.bark: Meh-eh-eh.

npcs.name: Constable Pip Harrow
npcs.title: The Reeve's Constable
npcs.bark: Halt! Er. Carry on. But carefully.

npcs.name: Wat Turnbull
npcs.title: Turnip Farmer
npcs.bark: That was a turnip. Now it's a hole.

npcs.name: Mother Delve
npcs.title: Eldest of the Mudpaw
npcs.bark: Mind the roof, dear. It's our floor.

npcs.name: Pebble
npcs.title: Mudpaw Cart-Pusher
npcs.bark: Rocks! Rocks! Rocks! (He likes rocks.)

npcs.name: Jory Ditchwater
npcs.title: Harvest Hand (Reformed)
npcs.bark: Stand and deliv— sorry. Habit. Lovely day for a harvest.

npcs.name: Jory Ditchwater
npcs.title: Captain of the Ditchwater Gang
npcs.bark: Stand and deliver!

npcs.name: Burrowmaster Grubb
npcs.title: Foreman of the Mudpaw
npcs.bark: Off our roof!

npcs.name: Warchief Skarra Duskmane
npcs.title: Matriarch of the Duskmane
npcs.bark: Supper is served.
